verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a processor. A data-training opt-out is a policy or setting of a service or software that collects user data, so this story is a category error for a chip. The evidence only covers on-device inference performance and ML frameworks, which does not show the chip offers any opt-out from AI training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
